method: Complete Nasdaq forward earnings-calendar sweep, accepted as Track B on 2026-07-29, plus the canonical prior-report +91d cadence estimate required by rules.md; the retired price-signature heuristic is not used.
classification_note: A future observed row is exact. Otherwise a future date is estimated as the latest confirmed prior report +91d with a ±5d band, while a complete forward sweep independently checks the near-term window.
